claims.statement: Tom Allen's place at 619 Market street advertised a free concert, and boxing by the city's most scientific boxers, every evening.
claims.excerpt: Free concert; also, boxing by the most scientific boxers of the city every evening.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was advertised as the retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: TOM ALLEN, Retired Champion Pugilist of the World, 619 Market street.

notes: Most of the column is about inn signs and is not about Allen.
